name: hotdata-memory
description: Keeps an agent's memory as an append-only table in the Hotdata database the project already queries. No dependencies beyond the hotdata CLI.

database.title: Database
database.description: The Hotdata database this project queries. Memory becomes a table in it, so one statement reads memory beside the data. Leave empty to keep memory in a local JSON file instead.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'mirror' follows Claude's own memory files. 'standalone' makes the table the only memory, for a project with auto memory off.

project.title: Project
project.description: Name the project instead of letting the repository or the directory name it. Records live under <scope prefix>/<project>.

budget.title: Context budget
budget.description: Characters of memory loaded at session start.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: SQL alias of the database. Read from the database when empty.

memory_root.title: Memory root
memory_root.description: Directory under which a written .md file counts as a memory note, in mirror mode. Defaults to ~/.claude/projects.

memory_file.title: Memory file
memory_file.description: Where memory goes when no database is configured.
